results.name: startup all-template matrix: fresh per-scope evaluation at every admission (team up B1 / team down B5 / worker down B3 / optional degraded B2 / persona pass B9 / persona fatal B9b)
results.note: all-ready admission: delegate T->worker EXECUTED (no control request, worker DONE) :: toolOk=false targetInstanceId=? doneWitness=false pendingControlRequests=0

results.name: optional requirement consent: auto-degraded proceed (B2) + durable optional-requirement-accepted fact readable, gate still ignores it (B2b)
results.note: auto-degraded: optional (complete:false) mcp down -> delegate EXECUTED, no control request (S1 degraded cell) :: toolOk=true doneWitness=false pendingControlRequests=0

results.name: required template disable: delegate -> gateReason templateDisabled (availability, never policy — negative #9)
Team-level required outage: admitInitialWork COMPATIBILITY_BLOCKED citing source requirement-gate; disable cannot bypass (B5/B6)
Leader required MCP down (team-scope model): team scope blocked -> Recovery
Human-reviewed recovery dispatch: the kit as human resolver, ALLOW -> recovery attempt proceeds on the reduced original authority
degraded Member controlled bash repair: read executes (original allow), bash opens an ASK request (recovery does not turn ask into allow — negative #2), executes after approval
service restored -> next boundary NORMAL: incident CLOSED durable, follow-up without recovery correlation, mcp materialized (E.10; no durable recovery flag)
exact reviewed payload: recovery-dispatch/v1 shape + reducedAuthority + effect + kind user-approval + inline + recovery:<token>:<seq> + canonical sha256 digest recomputed
deny / close / abort zero effect: DENY typed block (no new member/incident); abort -> control-request-abandoned + typed abandoned block; later allow rejected (terminal)
restarts persist, readiness resets: consent + disable facts survive all restarts and drive the fresh evaluation; the compatibility row is recomputed per boot
PR #22 ptc persona regression: standard observed -> PASS (correct open); absent observed -> FATAL PERSONA_INCOMPATIBLE + admitInitialWork blocked (no false open)
old v1 frozen blueprint cold resume: byte-exact pre-PR-E source -> SAME pre-PR-E contentHash under the PR-E code; cold resume re-attaches with the hash unchanged
dual-Team isolation: T2 proceeds while T is in a recovery incident; per-root durable state (no cross-team incident/control facts)
test-use pristine BEFORE + AFTER (porcelain empty, HEAD baseline); :3080/:3180 zero-touch (pre == post); the worker bash is a no-op echo
all run ports released after teardown (worldCleaned=true on PASS only)
